priority_items.title: PNG — Bougainville referendum ratification deferred to 20–21 Oct; 89/118 threshold restated; no vote this cutoff
priority_items.summary: The National (14 Oct): Leader of Government Business Peter Tsiamalili Jr listed two days of debate on 20–21 Oct after this week’s condolences for Daulo MP Gorosahu. Three-quarter majority 89 of 118 restated. NBC 41142 (13 Oct 11:14 PGT) framed the October sitting as the Peace Agreement ratification window; Melanesian Framework only if Parliament votes yes; ABG leftover self-government by Sep 2027 / independence declaration 2030. No division tallied. Not extra-constitutional. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: FJI — Acting AG/Justice Minister Turaga resigns; CRC submissions 12–23 Oct; extension CLAIM; HIV Bill passed 1 Oct (gap)
priority_items.summary: FBC 13 Oct 15:06 FJT (RNZ in-window 18:38 UTC): Rabuka accepted Siromi Turaga’s Cabinet resignation after an explicit video; remains MP/PAP; Solicitor-General covers legal advice. FHRC (FBC 14 Oct 06:00 FJT) flagged an 11-day public-submission window to 23 Oct. Fiji Times: Rabuka considering a mid-November sitting that could slip the 9 Dec referendum. Gap residual: second reading 38–5–9 on 2 Oct; HIV-AIDS Amendment Bill passed 1 Oct. Not extra-constitutional. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: PIF/UN — PIC statements on 24 Sep sea-level declaration: political framework, legal gaps; PRF pledges US$190m (9 Oct residual)
priority_items.summary: PINA 14 Oct of 12 Oct UNGA debate: PNG called out ‘veto by attrition’; Palau for PIF pressed PRF capitalisation and 1.5°C; Kiribati (PSIDS) human rights/non-refoulement; Tuvalu maritime-zone permanence; Vanuatu cited the 2025 ICJ AO. Declaration adopted 24 Sep is political, not a legal shield. Forumsec 9 Oct residual: Fiji US$10m + Denmark US$2.3m + Netherlands US$1m; total pledges US$190m vs US$500m end-2026 target. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: AUKUS — HII Newport News awarded US$56m Navy engineering/design contract (option US$91m)
priority_items.summary: HII 13 Oct: NNS awarded US$56 million FMS/USIS contract for AUKUS engineering and design; option to US$91 million. Supports UK/Australia technology insertion, supply chain, workforce, digital transformation, and SSN-AUKUS design. Jane’s 2026-10-14T02:36:59Z. Not a Virginia-class transfer, not Australian force-posture change, not a Pacific base. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Climate — NIWA/FMS 2026–27 cyclone outlooks; no named SW Pacific system this cutoff
priority_items.summary: Earth Sciences NZ 14 Oct: 7–11 named TCs Nov–Apr; at least four Cat 3+ possible anywhere; elevated east of Date Line (WSM/TKL/parts KIR); near-normal FJI/TON; normal-to-reduced NCL/VUT. FMS (FBC 14 Oct 07:10 FJT): 2–3 TCs through Fiji EEZ, 1–2 severe; RSMC Nadi 11–15 named. BoM desk 403 / browser 200, LM 03:01:24Z. No named SW Pacific cyclone. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: PNG — Gerehu firearms cache (raid 8 Oct; RNZ 14 Oct); Porgera September killings delayed reporting
priority_items.summary: RNZ 13 Oct 23:43 UTC: Manning said specialist units executed Gerehu warrants on 8 Oct; assembled rifles, parts, 3D-printing kit; one adult male in custody; international syndicate CLAIM. Asia Pacific Report 13 Oct: ≥8 dead at Porgera on 23 Sep; local blame on Kumul 23; police deny. Not capital-level unrest. Not FLASH.
